mapper.sql:
FROM learn_task_assignment a JOIN learn_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN edu_student s ON s.id=a.student_id WHERE
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student ps WHERE ps.student_id=a.student_id AND ps.parent_user_id=#{scope.userId} AND ps.status='ACTIVE') AND (t.status='PUBLISHED' OR (t.source_type='FAMILY' AND t.creator_user_id=#{scope.userId}))
((t.source_type='TEACHER' AND t.creator_user_id=#{scope.userId}) OR (t.source_type='ORGANIZATION' AND t.status='PUBLISHED')) AND a.source_type IN ('TEACHER','ORGANIZATION') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization sc JOIN edu_teacher_class tc ON tc.class_organization_id=sc.organization_id AND tc.teacher_user_id=#{scope.userId} AND tc.status='ACTIVE' WHERE sc.student_id=a.student_id AND sc.relation_type='CLASS' AND sc.status='ACTIVE')
t.source_type='ORGANIZATION' AND a.source_type='ORGANIZATION' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization org WHERE org.id=t.source_organization_id
AND org.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(#{root},'%') 1=0 )
1=0
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.id AS student_id,s.student_name ORDER BY s.student_name,s.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learn_task_assignment a WHERE

SELECT a.id,s.student_name,t.title,a.source_type,a.current_status AS status, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.amount),0) FROM growth_point_ledger l WHERE l.source_assignment_id=a.id AND l.change_type IN ('TASK_REWARD','CORRECTION')) AS points, c.status AS review_status FROM learn_task_assignment a JOIN learn_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN edu_student s ON s.id=a.student_id LEFT JOIN learn_task_checkin c ON c.assignment_id=a.id AND c.submission_no=(SELECT MAX(latest.submission_no) FROM learn_task_checkin latest WHERE latest.assignment_id=a.id) WHERE AND a.id > #{cursor} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
